name: Amazon Polly
tagline: Amazon Polly is AWS's cloud-based text-to-speech service that converts text into lifelike speech using deep learning, offering dozens of neural voices across 30+ languages. It's available via API with per-character pricing, making it cost-effective for applications that generate large volumes of audio. Developers building accessibility features, voice apps, and IVR systems use Polly as the infrastructure-grade TTS behind their products.
